# TDD and Testing Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the test strategy is specified completely, measurably and in a way that makes test-first discipline verifiable.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is red-green-refactor required, with evidence of the red phase (observed failure reason) specified as an artifact? [Completeness, CON IV; Plan §10.2] [D24] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all seven required test categories specified and mapped to suites? [Completeness, Spec §NFR-TST-001; Plan §10.1] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Does every orchestration failure path (retry, timeout, fallback, rollback, compensation, safe-stop, resume, replanning) have a required test category? [Coverage, Plan §10.1; Spec §SC-005, §SC-006] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Are negative tests required for every governance rule (agent approval, stale version, silence, rework limit)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-004, §SC-011] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the fault-injection harness specified with its fault types and default-off rule? [Completeness, Plan §10.3; ADR-018] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Are contract tests specified (drift, schemathesis, schema validation of emitted documents)? [Completeness, ADR-007] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Are the conditions under which TDD is impractical enumerated, with a requirement to record the reason? [Clarity, CON IV; Plan §10.4] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is coverage quantified, together with its package scope? [Measurability, PVT-007] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the concurrency test target quantified? [Measurability, PVT-003] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is a repeat-run determinism test required with defined comparison criteria? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-DET-001, §SC-010] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it specified that task completion requires executed validation, not generated code? [Clarity, CON IV; CON XI] [D31] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Are performance measurements PVT-001/002 specified as non-gating, with the measurement environment defined? [Clarity, Spec §A-009; DQ-009] [Optional]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Is it required that automated tests and scenario evidence use deterministic mode only? [Consistency, Spec §FR-ORC-029] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Is it required that every test carries requirement IDs, so that orphan tests are detectable? [Traceability, Spec §FR-OBS-010 (CR-003); Plan §13] [D29] [Mandatory]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK015 Is the ordering rule "specification and failing test precede implementation" stated in a form that violations can be detected from history (commit order or task log)? [Gap, CON I; CON IV] [D24] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
